summary: Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria, S.A. filed a preliminary Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement dated November 4, 2026, covering three series of senior non-preferred notes: fixed rate notes due 2029, fixed rate notes due 2036, and floating rate notes due 2029. Principal amounts, coupons, and issue/maturity dates are left blank pending pricing. The notes are direct, unconditional, unsecured obligations of the issuer and rank junior to senior preferred obligations and deposits under Spanish insolvency law. This is a routine debt shelf takedown, not a special situation; no equity or deal terms apply.
